name: Mohsen Sohrabi
about: Senior Front-End Developer with over 9 years of specialized experience in designing, implementing, and scaling data-driven web applications, enterprise systems, and FinTech platforms. Expert in modern Angular architectures, designing scalable Design Systems, managing Nx Monorepo workflows, and handling real-time data streams using RxJS and WebSockets. Proven track record of publishing practical open-source libraries, aligning cross-functional product and UI/UX teams, and optimizing performance for high-traffic environments.

workExperiences.title: Front-End Developer
tasks: Design System Architecture & Development: Architected and implemented a scalable, modular component library based on Design Tokens in close collaboration with product and UI/UX teams; significantly reduced development time for new features and ensured visual consistency across the platform.

Trading Module Optimization: Re-engineered the rendering of high-volume, volatile market data using custom Change Detection strategies and OnPush, drastically reducing CPU and browser memory consumption.

Cross-Platform WebSocket Service with Auto-Failover: Developed a robust WebSocket communication mechanism ensuring stable connections to backup servers and automatic reconnection with minimal latency during high-traffic trading scenarios.

workExperiences.title: Front-End Developer
tasks: Infrastructure Monitoring Modules: Redesigned UI modules for monitoring systems, focusing on separation of concerns, modularity, and high maintainability.
CI/CD Automation via Azure DevOps: Integrated automated UI testing and builds into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, accelerating the release cycle and minimizing human error during deployments.
Technical Documentation & Culture: Authored architectural guidelines, component design standards, and front-end technical documentation to streamline the onboarding process for new team members.

workExperiences.title: Front-End Developer
tasks: Open Banking Portals: Developed secure, real-time Open Banking services utilizing WebSocket protocols for stable data exchange
Nx Monorepo Implementation: Standardized and migrated multiple web applications into a unified Nx Monorepo workspace, facilitating optimal code sharing and faster build times.
Local Environment Standardization via Docker: Integrated front-end development requirements with Docker containers in close coordination with the DevOps/infrastructure team.

workExperiences.title: Front-End Developer
tasks: Enterprise ERP Subsystems: Developed scalable UI modules for treasury, accounting, warehousing, and sales chain management.
Dynamic Form & Report Builders: Reduced front-end dependency on database changes by engineering dynamic form and report modules tailored to diverse client scenarios.
Progressive Web App (PWA) Development: Designed and launched a full PWA with offline caching capabilities, improving load speeds and mobile/tablet support.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Implemented user access controls and organizational roles utilizing Angular Route Guards and Custom Directives.

workExperiences.title: Full-stack Developer
tasks: Designed and developed websites and admin panels using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, alongside ASP.NET MVC / Web API backends and SQL Server / MySQL databases.
